sql: ALTER TABLE ml_model.model ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS spectral_domain TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS spectral_unit TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS band_min REAL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS band_max REAL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS band_step REAL;

UPDATE ml_model.model m SET spectral_domain = s.d, spectral_unit = s.u, band_min = s.mn, band_max = s.mx, band_step = s.st FROM (SELECT id, min(split_part(c, '_', 1)) AS d, min(split_part(c, '_', 2)) AS u, min(split_part(c, '_', 3)::real) AS mn, max(split_part(c, '_', 3)::real) AS mx, (max(split_part(c, '_', 3)::real) - min(split_part(c, '_', 3)::real)) / NULLIF(count(*) - 1, 0) AS st FROM ml_model.model, jsonb_array_elements_text(manifest->'input'->'columns') AS c WHERE c ~ '^(wl|wn)_(nm|um|cm-1)_[0-9.]+$' GROUP BY id HAVING count(DISTINCT split_part(c, '_', 1) || split_part(c, '_', 2)) = 1) s WHERE m.id = s.id AND m.band_min IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS model_spectral_idx ON ml_model.model (indicator_id, spectral_domain, spectral_unit, band_min, band_max, band_step);
